label: Focal Figure
description: The single figure the eye lands on inside a massed battle — pose, gear-state and story in one glance. Full detail budget goes here.

items.name: standard-bearer
items.text: a standard-bearer sprinting three strides ahead of the front rank, banner pole couched like a lance, the cloth cracking taut overhead

items.name: mounted-commander
items.text: a commander on a rearing grey destrier, sword flung out toward the enemy line, cloak and horsehair crest streaming the same direction as the banners

items.name: shield-maiden
items.text: a shield-maiden braced in a gap of the wall, boots ploughed into the mud, shield rim split back to the boss, eyes level over its edge

items.name: war-priest
items.text: a war-priest striding through the press, a gilded reliquary raised overhead on both palms, its gold the single brightest point on the field

items.name: horn-caller
items.text: a horn-caller stood on a broken cart, cheeks bellowed around a bronze war-horn taller than its bearer, heads turning down the ranks in a visible wave

items.name: kneeling-veteran
items.text: a grey-bearded veteran down on one knee, notched sword planted as a crutch, helm gone, free arm still waving the line forward

items.name: battle-mage
items.text: a battle-mage mid-incantation at the line's center, scorched coat-hems lifting in an updraft of the spell's own making, light gathering between spread hands

items.name: berserker
items.text: a bare-armed berserker vaulting the shield-rims into the press, axe trailing an arc of rainwater, mouth open around a shout the picture almost carries

items.name: champions-duel
items.text: two champions locked blade-to-blade in a pocket of open ground the armies have left them, both hosts' banners planted at the circle's edge

items.name: braced-pike
items.text: a lone soldier planting a barbed war-pike against a diving shadow, braced low with the butt-spike in the earth, the field's whole fate narrowed to one set point

items.name: healer-kneeling
items.text: a healer kneeling in the churned mud beside a downed knight, satchel open, both hands steady in the middle of all that stillness

items.name: banner-gatherer
items.text: a soldier walking the ruts with an armful of fallen banners, the wet bundled cloth hanging heavier across the shoulder than any shield

items.name: unhelmed-king
items.text: a king walking the field unhelmed, dented crown carried in one gauntlet, picking a slow path between the fallen

items.name: leaning-survivors
items.text: two mud-caked survivors leaning helm to helm in the emptied field, propping each other upright, one shield doing for the both of them
